name: Adaptive Contouring via Octree Vertex Clustering
definition: A method to construct multi-resolution iso-surfaces by clustering vertices of child cells in an octree into a single vertex in a topologically safe manner, allowing an arbitrary number of vertices per cell to reduce polygon count in flat regions.
summary: Adaptive Contouring via Octree Vertex Clustering extracts multi-resolution iso-surfaces by clustering child vertices into single ones, reducing polygon counts in flat regions while permitting multiple vertices per cell.
